author: Nintendo of America
description:
Another Eden Begins arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch this summer!  

Travel across time and space in an adventure for the ages. Another Eden Begins is written by Masato Kato, the visionary behind multiple RPG masterpieces including Chrono Trigger. 

Form your party by choosing from 19 unique characters. Uncover hidden fates of the world with over 10 time-bending endings based on the decisions you make in New Game+, available after clearing the game once.  

It’s not just about what you do on your journey... it’s also about when you do it! So be careful—in Another Eden Begins, time is what you make of it.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
REANIMAL releases Feb 13, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/reanimal-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01

Co-op mystery horror game REANIMAL, made by the creators of Little Nightmares I and II, presents a cinematic game world rife with tension and filled with unimaginable monsters.  

Slowly unravel the story of two orphaned siblings surviving unspeakable horrors on a mission to rescue their friends in a world torn apart. The main path is only one part of the fragmented REANIMAL narrative—unique stories lie within each mysterious location, making curiosity a key element in the experience. Players can Share the Scare in local and online co-op or play in single player with AI assist.
